source.head: ee7d58f4f32ec03d53312c39c8eeeff596b55c45
source.exact_delta: Relative f5, only one comment and retry_control's return expression change (+2/-2): existing ui_controls::owned(state.generation,retry) replaces keyed Column. The immutable whole diff changes only search_ui.rs. Fifth component parent, focus Task, handler, producer/Git consumer and helper bytes are unchanged.
source.scope: Independent narrow UX/source refresh of the actual correction and remaining evidence. This does not replace parallel whole-tree conservation/correctness reviews or re-audit the broad feature.

preserved_history.state: Original scoped source CLEAR and identified focus/held-press risks remain at ee06.
Historical f5 HOLD sealed before this successor review; not relabeled.
1954 actual pinned-dependency negative receipt read and SHA-verified after this reviewer's f5 HOLD. It supplies the primary-pinned keyed-column diagnosis; no executed widget/native result.

user_flow_source_verdict.visible_recovery: The existing error state still offers the standard own-line Retry search control. Current generation/error/root/active-key/query/context/modal guards and preserved query/options/root remain as reviewed at ee06.

focus_handoff.conclusion: After a valid Retry, the code batches the existing query_id focus operation with schedule_project_search. It targets the same still-rendered query field as Open and is independent of the75ms debounce. This addresses the prior source-level missing keyboard handoff; actual focus/caret/Tab behavior remains unrun.

held_press_owner.conclusion: The actual Retry control now passes its generation and standard unnamed button to the existing Owned wrapper. Owner mismatch explicitly replaces wrapper state and rebuilds child Tree via Tree::new; that creates widget.state() and children(), rather than ordinary-diffing a retained pressed ButtonState. Equal generation uses ordinary child diff, retaining a valid in-progress press.

user_flow_source_verdict.no_new_policy: This correction adds neither automatic retry/polling nor a generic Git-change restart, new filesystem work, label/width policy or provider/authority path.
user_flow_source_verdict.labels_and_narrow_layout: Retry search retains the shared accessible name/style, short label and its own row below the error caption. The ownership wrapper forwards child sizing/layout; no source layout regression is identified. Actual wrapping, focus outline, clipping and reachability still require wide/narrow native evidence.
user_flow_source_verdict.result: The specific visible recovery, source focus and stale-held-Retry concerns are addressed at this exact source. No remaining concrete UX/source blocker was established in this narrow successor delta.

component_oracle.production_binding: Calls the actual retry_control used by project_search_panel, keeps its actual Tree across mouse events/rerender, obtains the real focusable button bounds through Widget::operate, then calls Widget::update through the shared pointer_step helper.
discriminating_controls: Press on generation41, change error and generation to42, diff/rerender, release: no message.
Following that refusal, a fresh press/release on42 emits Retry42.
Change only diagnostic text while generation remains41: the original press/release still emits Retry41.
component_oracle.source_prediction: The explicit owned child-tree replacement supplies the intended changed-generation reset, while equality retains the unchanged-generation control. This is a source-derived expectation, not a passed assertion.
component_oracle.unchanged_test_constraints: Fifth parent and all previous test bodies are unchanged by ee7d. Existing result_pointer_step continues delegating the original production result Element to the same layout/event delivery body; no old oracle was weakened to admit the fix.
not_proven: No native window, OS pointer capture, touch delivery, rendering/compositor or actual device input was exercised.
No keyboard focus Task was executed by this mouse component fixture.
No original monitor→Git change→retirement→75ms Run→physical B worker/channel flow was executed.
No Rust compilation or test-executable inventory/result was observed. Five source-declared new parents are not five passes.

remaining_native_evidence.all: UNRUN; required before full flow/readiness acceptance.
remaining_native_evidence.application: Actual development-runner native app with private local A/B Git/checkout fixtures and matched executable set under a later real admission. No live provider is required for this local search flow. No launch/grant is supplied here.
minimum_complete_flow: With an actual A search streaming, replace the exact root at the same path/key. Retain original event/drain, cancellation/generation, debounce/Run and original worker-output ordering to establish that queued old Batch/Error/Finished never presents as B.

Keep W absent beyond75ms, observe the real current-generation folder error and visible Retry. Restore valid same-key B; activate Retry without editing the query/options. Require fresh B result/completion and correct result opening/line selection, with old output still refused.

Keyboard-only: Tab to Retry, press Enter, verify query focus/caret/text after the button disappears, then use arrow selection/Enter to open a fresh B result without lost focus or an excessive recovery Tab cycle.

Actual held Retry and result pointer/touch gestures across generation/error replacement: release must not retarget. Keep the same-generation rerender and fresh-press positive controls so a disabled/nonfunctional button cannot qualify.

Ordinary edits/rescan/poll/other-root events while searching: generation/run provenance must show no unnecessary repeated restart, blanking or focus theft. Inspect hover, scrolling and spinner/result transitions on the same realistic workload.

Affected populated, transient empty/searching, error/Retry and recovered-result states at wide and narrow inspector widths. Check notice wrapping, visible focus, fully reachable Retry, scroll position and primary result activation.
remaining_native_evidence.evidence_honesty: A headless widget fixture is component evidence only. A state fixture loaded in the native app can establish rendering/interaction if labeled, but cannot establish native watcher/physical-root/worker causality. Physical rename plus a final screenshot alone is insufficient.
remaining_native_evidence.screenshots: Matching actual native Before/After WebP pairs at the stated revisions, same viewport/scale/theme/private data/state, two columns labeled Before/After with state description beneath. Keep images on a separate screenshot branch with immutable commit links. No captures exist from this review.
remaining_native_evidence.responsiveness: Matched before/final-after frame stalls and relevant resource behavior, including ordinary event bursts and retry-to-result behavior. No first-result200ms, no-stall or resource claim is established here.
remaining_native_evidence.independent_ux_acceptance: Give the reviewer actual native interaction evidence and tested-head pins. Resolve primary-flow failures and affected evidence gaps before calling ready. Later source changes require affected evidence/review refresh.

final_limits.format: Root's freeze records official formatting/diff success; those remain attributed source checks, not execution of product/test/native bodies.
final_limits.historical_limits: Missed/ambiguous root notifications, physical-before-worker-open guarantees, blocked filesystem cancellation latency and broader search performance remain their existing scoped limits.
final_limits.actions: Only own /tmp receipt/checksum writes. No source/test edits, imports/builds/tests/native/runtime/env/process/account/provider probes, Git/GitHub writes or new workers.
